title: Food on Film
theme: Famous foods in Disney and Pixar films
intro: [excited] Hello, hungry people! Tonight's board is a movie buffet: famous foods from Disney and Pixar films. Pasta, porridge, pies, and one very suspicious bowl of cream. [chuckles] Let's eat!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cinema-style banquet: a long table under a glowing movie screen piled with a bowl of pesto pasta, a lattice-top pie, a plate of golden arepas, a glass of milk and a bowl of popcorn, red velvet curtains.

categories.title: Pasta in Portorosso
categories.intro: Our film category is Luca! A seaside Italian town, two sea monster boys, and a whole lot of pasta.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunny Italian Riviera fishing village with pastel houses, a harbour full of little boats, a cobblestone piazza with a plate of green pesto pasta on a café table and a red scooter parked nearby.

clues.clue: Luca and Alberto look like regular boys on land, but they're secretly these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is sea monsters! [gasps] Get wet and the scales pop right out. Not ideal on a rainy day.

clues.clue: Luca and Alberto dream of owning one of these Italian scooters.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Vespa! [laughs] Piacere, Girolamo Trombetta! They just want to ride off and see the world.

clues.clue: Besides swimming and biking, Portorosso Cup racers must eat a big plate of this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is pasta! [chuckles] A triathlon where one event is eating. Sign me up immediately.

clues.clue: The smug local bully who has won the Portorosso Cup five years in a row is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ercole Visconti! [sighs] Ercole and his Vespa. Nobody likes him, and he likes himself enough for everybody.

clues.clue: Giulia's dad Massimo serves the boys this specific pasta dish, which Luca loves.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is trenette al pesto! A flat ribbon pasta with basil pesto, a specialty of the Italian Riviera, where Luca is set. Delizioso!

categories.title: Movie Munchies
categories.intro: Next up, Movie Munchies! Name the famous foods characters crave, cook, or refuse to eat.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cosy movie-night living room with a honey pot, a peanut butter sandwich, a slice of broccoli pizza and a steaming bowl of soup on a coffee table.

clues.clue: Winnie the Pooh can never get enough of this sticky treat, which he keeps in pots.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is honey! [chuckles] Or as Pooh spells it, H-U-N-N-Y. Oh bother.

clues.clue: Lilo leaves this kind of sandwich for Pudge the fish, because she's sure he controls the weather.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is peanut butter! [laughs] Pudge controls the weather, so you have to keep him happy. That's just science.

clues.clue: In Inside Out, Riley's Disgust goes wild when a San Francisco pizza place only serves pizza with this topping.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is broccoli! [laughs] Congratulations, San Francisco, you ruined pizza. Anger said it best.

clues.clue: In Tangled, Mother Gothel promises to make this soup, Rapunzel's favourite, for dinner.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is hazelnut soup! [whispers] Mother Gothel's way of saying I love you. Totally not a manipulation tactic.

clues.clue: Snow White bakes this kind of pie for Grumpy, just before the Evil Queen comes calling.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is gooseberry pie! [chuckles] Grumpy pretends not to care, but you know he wanted a slice.

categories.title: Name That Movie Meal
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a famous dish from a film. Name the movie it comes from!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A white restaurant tablecloth with five covered silver serving domes, one slightly lifted to reveal a warm golden glow, candles and a menu without writing.

clues.clue: Name the movie that made this dish famous.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ratatouille! A peasant dish that made the toughest food critic in Paris remember his mom's cooking. [sighs] Beautiful.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An elegant white plate with a spiral of thinly sliced zucchini, eggplant, tomato and yellow squash arranged in a neat fan over red pepper sauce, a sprig of herb on top, in a candlelit Paris bistro.

clues.clue: Name the movie where these powdered treats are a dream come true.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Princess and the Frog! Tiana's beignets are so good Charlotte orders them by the dozen. [laughs] Okay, by the hundred.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A plate stacked high with square fried beignets buried in powdered sugar on a café table in 1920s New Orleans, a brass trumpet and a lily pad nearby, a riverboat on the river at dusk.

clues.clue: Name the movie where this food can heal any cut or bruise.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Encanto! Julieta's arepas con queso heal anything. [chuckles] Bruno's gift would be more useful if it came with arepas.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A plate of golden grilled corn cakes stuffed with melting white cheese on a colourful tiled kitchen counter, a small bandage beside the plate, yellow butterflies floating in the sunlight.

clues.clue: Name the movie where a tiny guardian cooks this cheerful breakfast.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mulan! Mushu makes her porridge with egg eyes and a bacon smile. [laughs] Then the porridge looks back at her.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A wooden bowl of rice porridge with two fried eggs for eyes and a strip of bacon for a smiling mouth, on a table in a traditional Chinese farmhouse at dawn, a rooster outside the window.

clues.clue: Name the movie where this drink's bottle cap becomes a badge of friendship.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Up! Little Ellie gives Carl a grape soda cap and makes him a member of her club. [sighs] Now I need a moment.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 4:3, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A purple grape soda bottle cap pinned like a badge onto a knitted sweater vest, next to an empty glass jar and a tiny wooden toy blimp, warm attic light.

categories.title: Dine Like the Movies
categories.intro: Parks time! At the parks, you can eat inside the movies. [laughs] Just don't feed the animatronics.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A theme park dining terrace with tables under strings of lights, a bayou-style restaurant, a giant oversized sandwich on a lab bench and a glass of blue milk on a desert counter.

clues.clue: This New Orleans Square restaurant at Disneyland, opened in 2023, is named after Tiana's dream restaurant.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tiana's Palace! [excited] Beignets AND gumbo. Tiana finally got her restaurant... and so did we.

clues.clue: Satu'li Canteen at Animal Kingdom serves food inspired by the moon Pandora from this James Cameron film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Avatar! [laughs] Pandora: The World of Avatar opened in 2017. The food is not blue. I checked.

clues.clue: At Galaxy's Edge, guests can drink this colour of milk, which Luke Skywalker sips at home on Tatooine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is blue milk! [chuckles] Green milk is also on the menu, which comes from a sea cow. Bon appétit, galaxy.

clues.clue: Pym Test Kitchen in Avengers Campus serves super-sized and shrunken food inspired by this size-changing hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ant-Man! [laughs] Giant pretzels, tiny burgers. Pym particles are great for portion control.

clues.clue: At Disneyland Paris, this Ratatouille-themed restaurant makes guests feel rat-sized, surrounded by giant plates, utensils and bottles.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Bistrot Chez Rémy! Giant plates, giant forks, and you're the size of a rat. [chuckles] Ego would approve.

categories.title: Just Desserts
categories.intro: Our fan category is Just Desserts! Sweets, treats and one dessert that a villain definitely shouldn't have served. [chuckles]

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A candy-coloured dessert cart piled with frosted cakes, swirled lollipops, a fizzy cola bottle and a little bottle of cream, in a whimsical striped kitchen.

clues.clue: In Wreck-It Ralph, Vanellope races in Sugar Rush, a game world made almost entirely out of this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is candy! [laughs] The cops are donuts and the race track is frosting. My dentist hates this game.

clues.clue: In Alice in Wonderland, a cookie labelled with these two words makes Alice grow giant.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Eat Me! Drink Me shrinks her, Eat Me makes her grow. [chuckles] Wonderland portion sizes are wild.

clues.clue: In The Aristocats, the butler Edgar puts sleeping pills in this milky dish named after himself.
clues.answer: Crème de la crème à la Edgar
accept: creme de la creme a la edgar
crème de la crème à la edgar
choices: Crème de la crème à la Edgar
clues.reveal: The correct answer is crème de la crème à la Edgar! [gasps] Rule number one: never trust a butler who names dessert after himself.

clues.clue: In Pinocchio, naughty boys gorge on cake, pie and candy at this island, until they turn into donkeys.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pleasure Island! [whispers] And then the donkeys get shipped off. Kids' movie, everybody.

clues.clue: In Wreck-It Ralph, Sugar Rush's volcano is a fizzy mountain built from these two ingredients.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Diet Cola and Mentos! Diet Cola Mountain, where Ralph saves the day with a very big fizz. [laughs] Do not try this at home.
